blurb: Come stay with us! We are a family-owned RV park, built on 12 serene acres, and located less than a minute's drive from I-10. The park offers seventy-seven clean gravel-lined sites with adjacent concrete patios. Every site features a picnic table, palm tree, and full hook ups for 50 and 30 amp RVs. Other amenities include free Cable TV, reliable WiFi, and a coin-operated laundry facility.
hoursText: open 7 days a week from 9am to 5pm
